VAKKU_PHD-EARRING.title: Search Settings
VAKKU_PHD-EXTRA_ENERGY.title: +1 Energy
VAKKU_PHD-EXTRA_ENERGY.hover.desc: The relic's +1 energy per turn. Turn this off to play it as a pure autoplayer.
VAKKU_PHD-EVERY_TURN.title: Play every turn
VAKKU_PHD-EVERY_TURN.hover.desc: Vanilla plays cards on turn 1 only. On: it plays your hand on every turn.
VAKKU_PHD-SEARCH_SECONDS.title: Search time
VAKKU_PHD-SEARCH_SECONDS.hover.desc: How long it thinks before each card.
VAKKU_PHD-OBSERVE_ONLY.title: Observe only
VAKKU_PHD-OBSERVE_ONLY.hover.desc: Vanilla plays the cards; the search's choice is only written to the log.
VAKKU_PHD-VALUES.title: Meta-scaling Values
VAKKU_PHD-MAX_HP_VALUE.title: Max HP value
VAKKU_PHD-MAX_HP_VALUE.hover.desc: How many HP one point of max HP is worth to the search.
VAKKU_PHD-GOLD_PER_HP.title: Gold per HP
VAKKU_PHD-GOLD_PER_HP.hover.desc: How much gold is worth 1 HP. Lower: gold matters more (Hand of Greed, thieves).
VAKKU_PHD-STOLEN_CARD_HP.title: Stolen card value
VAKKU_PHD-STOLEN_CARD_HP.hover.desc: HP a card is worth when a Thieving Hopper escapes with it.
VAKKU_PHD-ADVANCED.title: Advanced
VAKKU_PHD-PAIRED_SCENARIOS.title: Paired comparisons
VAKKU_PHD-PAIRED_SCENARIOS.hover.desc: Extra checks that compare the best plays under the same random draws. 0 turns them off (and the play-order check).
VAKKU_PHD-CARD_REMOVAL_HP.title: Card removal value
VAKKU_PHD-CARD_REMOVAL_HP.hover.desc: HP one card removal is worth. Forbidden Grimoire gives one after each won fight.
VAKKU_PHD-CARD_UPGRADE_HP.title: Card upgrade value
VAKKU_PHD-CARD_UPGRADE_HP.hover.desc: HP one random card upgrade is worth. Mad Science's Improvement gives one after each won fight.
VAKKU_PHD-CARD_REWARD_HP.title: Extra card reward value
VAKKU_PHD-CARD_REWARD_HP.hover.desc: HP an extra card reward is worth. Each kill with The Hunt adds one.
VAKKU_PHD-SCYTHE_GROWTH_HP.title: The Scythe growth value
VAKKU_PHD-SCYTHE_GROWTH_HP.hover.desc: HP each play of The Scythe from your deck is worth: it keeps its +5 damage for good.
VAKKU_PHD-GENETIC_ALGORITHM_GROWTH_HP.ho: HP each play of Genetic Algorithm from your deck is worth: it keeps its +3 block for good.
VAKKU_PHD-GOOPY_GROWTH_HP.title: Goopy growth value
VAKKU_PHD-GOOPY_GROWTH_HP.hover.desc: HP each play of a Goopy card from your deck is worth: it keeps its +1 block for good.
VAKKU_PHD-POTIONS.title: Potions
VAKKU_PHD-USE_POTIONS.title: Use potions
VAKKU_PHD-USE_POTIONS.hover.desc: Let the search drink potions during the Earring's turn.
VAKKU_PHD-POTIONS_ONLY_IN_DANGER.title: Only in danger
VAKKU_PHD-POTIONS_ONLY_IN_DANGER.hover.d: On: potions are used only when the fight looks bad, and a kept potion is not priced. Off: every potion has a price in HP (see Potion prices) and is used when the gain is worth more.
VAKKU_PHD-POTION_PRICES.title: Potion prices
VAKKU_PHD-POTION_PRICES.hover.desc: Your own price in HP for named potions, e.g. BLOOD_POTION=18, FIRE_POTION=10. Used when 'Only in danger' is off.

VAKKU_PHD-BUG_REPORT.title: Bug report
VAKKU_PHD-SAVE_LAST_FIGHT.title: Last fight with the Earring
VAKKU_PHD-SAVE_LAST_FIGHT.hover.desc: Saves the last fight (your deck, relics, HP, the enemies, the search's choices and any errors) to one readable file and opens its folder. Nothing is sent: attach the file to your bug report.
VAKKU_PHD-SAVE_REPORT.title: Save report
VAKKU_PHD-SHOW_FIGHT_BUTTON.title: Show report button in fights
VAKKU_PHD-SHOW_FIGHT_BUTTON.hover.desc: Adds a 'Save fight report' button to the combat screen while you hold the Whispering Earring. Takes effect from the next fight.
VAKKU_PHD-THINKING_BUBBLE.title: Thinking bubble
VAKKU_PHD-THINKING_BUBBLE.hover.desc: Vakku says 'Thinking...' above the Earring when its search takes more than a second.
VAKKU_PHD-DEBUG_SCREEN.title: Debug screen
VAKKU_PHD-DEBUG_SCREEN.hover.desc: While the Earring thinks, each card in your hand and the End Turn button show the share of the search's visits it has, updated every frame. The card with the most visits is played.
